title: Janus admin kiosk & snippet router for modular remediation
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build 'Janus': a lightweight admin kiosk that exposes a snippet router for composing and executing modular remediation snippets as discrete runbook-tasks. Janus unifies small admin utilities (snippets) with runbook scheduling, permissioned execution, and telemetry so first-line support can safely run repeatable fixes without full playbook overhead.
background: We repeatedly see ad-hoc shell snippets, short runbooks, and one-off support scripts proliferating in chat and ticket threads. They are hard to discover, often lack idempotency checks, and telemetry is sparse. Janus aims to: 1) centralize vetted snippets, 2) make them composable into runbook-tasks, 3) surface RBAC and safety gates, and 4) capture per-execution signals for quality/regression detection.
success_criteria: Catalog: 30 vetted snippets available in Janus catalog covering common DB/infra/ingest fixes
Execution: Support can launch a snippet-run as a one-click runbook-task with parameter validation and dry-run mode
Safety: No production snippet can be executed without RBAC and an execution approval policy
Telemetry: Each execution emits structured telemetry (who, params, elapsed, affected-resources) to ops-telemetry for alerting
Rollback: Snippet author can register a compensating snippet; system surfaces rollback option on failures
deliverables: Janus catalog UI (Console panel) with search, tagging, and preview
Snippet router service (HTTP API) that validates, composes, and schedules runbook-tasks
Snippet authoring spec and CLI for packaging idempotent snippets (YAML manifest)
Integration with Runbook Task Queue and existing Playbook Executor (task adapter)
Telemetry schema and dashboard for snippet executions
technical_notes: Snippet manifests declare inputs, required grants, dry-run command, compensating snippet (optional), and parameters schema (JSON Schema)
Router will perform static checks: param schema validation, replay-idempotency token requirement for destructive ops, and a whitelist of allowed CLIs/APIs per snippet
Execution path: Console -> Router API -> Task Queue -> Sandbox Executor -> Live Executor (with canary gating)
Use existing SSO/SCIM for RBAC; add granular snippet-level grants integrated with Customer RBAC mappings
Store snippet artifacts in artifact store (signed packages). Use KMS for secrets referenced in manifests via vault references, not embedded in snippets
Telemetry uses opentelemetry format; events posted to ops-telemetry ingestion with tag runbook.snippet and fields for param hash, execution outcome, and revert token
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal SRE + Support (20 users) with only non-destructive snippets enabled
Beta: expand to all support and oncall, enable compensating-snippet workflow and approval queue
GA: open catalog to ops console, enforce RBAC + approval for high-impact snippets and audit logs retention 90 days
testing_plan: Unit: manifest parser, schema validator, RBAC guard checks
Integration: end-to-end run (dry-run + live) against sandboxed staging clusters
Chaos: failure injection in executor to verify rollback/compensating snippet triggers
Telemetry: synthetic executions to validate dashboard metrics and alert rules
